name: Confirmed Liquidity Sweep Reversal
defn: After price sweeps a resting-liquidity level (prior-day/swing/session high/low) it must show a CONFIRMATION (displacement / close-back / consecutive-close) before a reversal entry.
behavior: Sweep of a level + confirmation is followed by mean-reversion away from the swept side.
econ: Stop/breakout orders pooled beyond levels are triggered to fill size; confirmation filters the genuine reversal from the continuation.
fam_pos: S1 (low/swing OOS +0.29; high/pdh short OOS +0.35; multiple RW)
fam_neg: S21 (raw sweep, no confirmation, all negative)
ev_pos: S1 confirmed variants: several RW, positive OOS on two representatives
ev_neg: S1 low/pdh OOS ~+0.01 (near null); large spec dispersion
next: confirmed vs unconfirmed sweep in a frozen side/regime-matched null
sources: results/FAMILY_RESULTS.parquet, results/ext_families/*.parquet, docs/S21_S40_IMPLEMENTATION_REPORTS.md, docs/S21_S31_TIERB_CONSOLIDATED.md, docs/MECHANISM_DIVERSITY_LOG.md, MECHANISM_REGISTRY.parquet, kb_dedup.json

name: Failed-Breakout Fade
defn: A breakout beyond a prior-day level that fails (closes back inside) is faded back into range.
behavior: Failed break at prior-day level reverts.
econ: Breakout buyers trapped on the failed extension are forced to unwind, feeding the fade.

name: Round-Number Momentum
defn: A clean break THROUGH a psychological round level ($100) continues; rejection at round levels does NOT work.
behavior: $100-level breakouts continue; rejections fade to noise.
econ: Clustered orders/stops at round levels; once cleared, momentum follows.
ev_neg: threshold ($100) may be selected; thin evidence

name: Trend Efficiency (gated continuation)
defn: Continuation entries only when the trend is CLEAN (high Kaufman efficiency ratio); skip choppy trends.
behavior: Continuation in efficient trends is weakly positive; raw continuation is negative.
econ: Clean trends persist; efficiency filters noise.
